newsitem.title: POLAND: Investors bid for PLN 1.45 bln of Polish bonds.
newsitem.headline: Investors bid for PLN 1.45 bln of Polish bonds.

text.p: Investors bid for a total of 1.447 billion zlotys worth of Polish 15-percent two-year bonds and 12-percent five-year bonds against a combined 800 million zloty offer, the National Bank of Poland said.
It said demand for the shorter paper was 929.1 million zlotys while bids for the longer one totalled 518.5 million zlotys.
Full details of the tender should be available later today.
